products.name: Samsung PRO Ultimate SDXC Card
products.summary: Full-size PRO Ultimate SD card rated for 200MB/s reads and 130MB/s writes, in 64GB to 512GB.
products.description: The Samsung PRO Ultimate full-size SDXC UHS-I card is rated for 200MB/s reads and 130MB/s writes for DSLR, mirrorless and PC workflows. It is sold in 64GB, 128GB, 256GB and 512GB.
products.keywords: samsung pro ultimate sd card 200mb/s camera
products.notes: Price is Samsung US msrpPrice for the listed configuration; several capacities showed as out of stock on samsung.com on the research date. No image: the only clean card photo in Samsung's gallery carries a promotional badge, other gallery images are lifestyle/text banners or packaging.

products.name: Angelbird AV PRO SE CFexpress B v4 MK2
products.summary: CFexpress v4 Type B card on PCIe 4.0 x2 with reads up to 3700MB/s and Stable Stream sustained writes, 256GB to 4TB.
products.description: Angelbird's AV PRO SE CFexpress B v4 MK2 uses a PCIe 4.0 x2 interface with max reads of 3700MB/s. Max/sustained writes scale with capacity: 550/500MB/s (256GB), 1100/1050MB/s (512GB), 2300/2100MB/s (1TB) and 3500/3150MB/s (2TB, 4TB). It has a 3-year limited warranty including free data recovery.
products.keywords: angelbird av pro se cfexpress b v4 12k raw stable stream
products.notes: USD prices from the product page JSON-LD offers (angelbird.com US, excl. tax). No image: Angelbird product-page imagery places the card over large decorative lettering, not a clean studio shot.

products.name: Angelbird AV PRO SD V60 MK2
products.summary: UHS-II V60 SDXC card with max reads of 280MB/s and 140MB/s sustained writes, 64GB to 1TB.
products.description: The Angelbird AV PRO SD V60 MK2 is an SD 6.1 UHS-II card rated C10, U3 and V60, with max read/write speeds of 280/160MB/s and sustained read/write of 260/140MB/s. It operates from -25 to 85 C and carries a 3-year limited warranty with free data recovery.
products.keywords: angelbird av pro sd v60 mk2 uhs-ii
products.notes: USD single-pack prices from the product page JSON-LD offers (angelbird.com US, excl. tax). No image: Angelbird product-page imagery places the card over large decorative lettering, not a clean studio shot.
